errors.text: Hi, admin dari group Kerja Kosong Lembah Klang here. Saya ada role 'Escrow Agent' untuk online marketplace kami. errors.text: Salam sejahtera. Kami memerlukan pemegang akaun tempatan untuk membantu pelanggan luar negara menukar ringgit kepada mata wang kripto. Anda akan menerima pemindahan, membeli USDT, dan menghantarnya ke alamat dompet yang diberi. Komisen 1.5% setiap transaksi.

errors.label: mule
errors.text: Tawaran Kerja: Penyelaras Transaksi Digital. Anda perlu daftar akaun e-dompet baharu menggunakan nama sendiri dan serahkan butiran log masuk kepada penyelia untuk tujuan pengurusan dana pelanggan. Bayaran RM350 bagi setiap akaun yang diaktifkan.

errors.label: job_scam
errors.text: Hello, sorry kacau. Ni Aina dari HR Northvale Recruitment. Kami dapat no. you dari job portal. Ada kerja online RM100-RM500 sehari, flexible time. Boleh I share detail through Telegram? Kena download app kami dulu untuk mula.

errors.text: Dear applicant, you have been shortlisted for the Retail Merchandise Promoter role. Kindly settle the uniform and name tag fee of RM85 before Friday so our logistics team can deliver them to you before your first day.

errors.label: job_scam
errors.text: Job Offer – Digital Voucher Fulfilment Associate (remote). Purchase digital gift cards from our approved list using your own card, send the codes to your supervisor, and receive reimbursement plus 12% within 24 hours.

errors.label: legit
errors.text: Hi, I saw your portfolio. My company need English to Chinese translator for our product catalogue, around 30 pages. Budget RM1,500. I can pay 30% deposit to your account first, balance after finish. Can sign freelance agreement.

errors.text: Peluang untuk pelajar IPT: Program Ejen Pembayaran Mikro. Syarikat kami memproses bayaran untuk platform pinjaman dalam talian. errors.label: mule
errors.text: Cari budak U nak buka akaun bank baru atas nama sendiri. Kami bayar RM800 satu akaun. Buka je, lepas tu bagi kad & login kat kami. Settle hari sama.

errors.label: mule
errors.text: Adik, akak ada job senang. Tolong keluarkan duit dari akaun adik je, nanti runner akak ambil kat ATM. Adik dapat RM150 setiap kali. Duit tu dari bisnes akak, tak payah risau.

errors.label: legit
errors.text: Salam. Saya ejen hartanah berdaftar. Perlukan pembantu sambilan untuk kemas kini rekod sewa, semak bayaran sewa yang masuk ke akaun syarikat, dan hantar peringatan kepada penyewa yang lewat bayar. RM15 sejam, 10 jam seminggu, di pejabat Setia Alam.

errors.label: job_scam
errors.text: Hi kak 😊 nak kerja part time tak? Just follow & like IG page je, RM8 setiap task. Lepas 5 task boleh masuk VIP group, komisen lagi tinggi!

errors.text: Thank you for your interest in the Product Data Optimisation role at Kirravel Analytics. Each shift you will complete 40 product data submissions on our merchant portal. errors.text: We are hiring a Company Director (nominee) for a newly incorporated trading company. No daily duties. You will sign the SSM forms and the corporate bank account opening documents; our team manages operations. One-time fee RM3,000 + RM500 monthly. Suitable for final-year students.

errors.text: Hey! Here's your RM30 for the first three tasks 😊 Next is a merchant welfare task: transfer RM100 to the merchant account and receive RM130 back within 10 minutes. The quota is limited, first come first served. If you skip, your subscription rewards will be reduced.

errors.text: Hi, I'm looking for someone to help my mother's tuition centre in Cheras collect monthly fees from parents (cash or online transfer to centre account) and update the record book. Saturday morning 9-1, RM60 per session.
